title: SkillData v1 (DRAFT)
$comment: PLACEHOLDER skeleton created in Phase 1.7. The authoritative SkillData v1 contract is finalized in Phase 3.7 (docs/skilldata_v1.md). Field names, units, and required/optional status may change before v1 is locked.
description: AI-training-ready motor-capture record: one trial of one subject performing one motion class, captured by the 4-IMU arm sleeve.

session.description: Per-trial metadata. motion_class is a first-class field.

motion_class.description: Motion label, e.g. reach, lift, wrist_rotate, throw.

calibration.description: Calibration coefficients applied to this capture (per calibration_protocol.md).

gyro_bias_dps.description: Per-sensor gyroscope bias (deg/s), keyed by sensor ID.

accel_scale.description: Per-sensor accelerometer scale factors, keyed by sensor ID.

inter_imu_alignment_quat.description: Per-sensor mounting-alignment quaternion [w,x,y,z] from the T-pose, keyed by sensor ID.

imu_streams.description: Raw + fused per-IMU time series, keyed by sensor ID (S0, S2, S4, S5).

quaternion.description: Fused orientation [w,x,y,z] per sample (added by the fusion stage).

saturation_flag.description: True where the gyro pinned at its full-scale range (D2 envelope).

segment_kinematics.description: Fused segment-level kinematics derived from relative IMU orientation (added by the fusion stage).

joint_angles_rad.description: Recovered joint angles over time (shoulder from S0-S2, elbow from S2-S4, wrist from S4-S5).
